body.rationale: Start at the top rung of block 0: a verified satisfying assignment at rung 4 would immediately settle rungs 0-4 as SATISFIABLE by subset monotonicity. Local search is the cheapest broad probe and cannot overclaim unsatisfiability.

The prior local search on block 0's hardest rung found no witness, which is not enough to claim UNSAT. Because monotonic propagation only works within a block, the next best action is an exact solve at the middle rung of the same block: a witness would settle rungs 0-2 as SATISFIABLE, while a refutation would settle rungs 2-4 as UNSATISFIABLE. This maximizes possible propagation from one bounded exact call.

Block 0 now has a completed refutation at rung 2, so by within-block monotonicity rungs 2, 3, and 4 are UNSATISFIABLE. Blocks are independent, so the next highest-value move is to probe the middle rung of a fresh block with exact solving; a refutation would settle rungs 7-9, while a witness would settle rungs 5-7.

The refutation at rung 7 also refutes higher rungs 8 and 9 within block 1, so those UNSAT claims should be added. Blocks 2 and 3 still have no evidence; exact solving the middle rung of block 2 is the highest-leverage next probe because a refutation would settle rungs 12-14, while a witness would settle rungs 10-12.

Blocks are independent, so the missing high-value evidence is block 3. In the first three blocks, exact solving the middle rung with unit_pure refuted it within budget, which also refuted all higher rungs in that block. Applying the same probe to rung 17 can potentially settle rungs 17, 18, and 19; if it instead finds a witness, it settles rungs 15, 16, and 17 as satisfiable.

Block 3 has a verified witness at rung 17, so rungs 15, 16, and 17 are now SATISFIABLE. The highest-value unresolved frontier is rung 18 in the same block: a witness would add rung 18, while a refutation would also refute rung 19. This uses one decision to target up to two remaining unresolved rungs without relying on cross-block inference.

Blocks are independent, so remaining uncertainty is rungs 0-1, 5-6, 10-11, and 18-19 status cleanup in block 3. The witness at rung 18 establishes SATISFIABLE for rung 18 as well as lower rungs 15-17. For the next probe, rung 6 is the best leverage point in block 1: a witness would settle both rungs 5 and 6 by downward monotonicity, while a refutation would at least settle rung 6 and confirm all higher rungs already implied by rung 7.
Final call: no further tool action will be executed. Claims use only block-local monotonic implications from verified witnesses and completed refutations; independent blocks are not cross-propagated.

Final call: no further action will be executed. Claims are limited to completed refutations and monotone closure within each independent block; all other rungs remain unresolved because the surviving boundary positions do not entail SAT or UNSAT.
